snapshot.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
snapshot.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges. [1]

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +9% YoY, NII +10%, PAT +6%

notes.text: Mar 2024 revenue jumped 66% — a step change (merger/acquisition?); CAGRs that straddle it overstate organic growth
Growth is accelerating: revenue CAGR 22% over 5y → 27% over 3y
Profit lagging revenue: PAT CAGR 20% vs revenue 27% (3y)
Lender: leverage is structural (deposits+borrowings ≈ 6.5× equity); judge on asset quality, not D/E
Lender: operating cash flow mostly reflects loan-book growth; cash conversion isn't a useful lens

red_flags.text: Profit lagging revenue: PAT CAGR 20% vs revenue 27% (3y)

business_mix.what_it_does: HDFC Bank Limited is a financial institution offering a wide range of banking and financial services including retail deposits, business banking, MSME loans, agricultural loans, and corporate banking.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management highlights positive trajectories and growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Net profit moved from 18627.0 crore in Sep 2024 to 21537.0 crore in Sep 2026.

promises.credibility: Management guidance is largely focused on future horizons and specific internal metrics like LCR or branch counts that cannot be verified from the high-level financial figures provided, leaving most claims pending or unknown.

bull: Growth is accelerating with 3y revenue CAGR at 27% compared to 5y revenue CAGR of 22%.
Latest quarter Sep 2026 showed strong top line with revenue up 9% YoY and NII up 10%.
Guidance expects net interest margins to be neutral to positive moving forward based on Oct 2026 data.
bear: Profit is lagging revenue growth as 3y PAT CAGR is 20% compared to revenue CAGR of 27%.
Mar 2024 revenue jumped 66% which creates a step change that overstates organic growth when straddled.
Latest quarter Sep 2026 PAT growth of 6% trails behind revenue growth of 9% YoY.
